answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a graduated trust ladder. New identities start on the lowest terrace, allowed only tiny, low-value tasks, and each completed job leaves a verifiable signal - a signed attestation from the counterparty. Climbing to higher terraces, where the real rewards grow, takes months of honest history. A Sybil farmer faces a bleak meadow of effort: every fake identity must slowly earn its way up, while one bad act burns the whole climb. The cost of patience defeats the cheapness of creation.
